notes.title: v2.0.0 Update
notes.notes:
Add a brand new Abyss challenge, entering the Abyss requires at least 500 layers and opening at least one Nightmare affix
Entering the Abyss Challenge requires a challenge ticket, which can be obtained through Nightmare Challenge with more than 500 levels. The higher the level, the more tickets can be obtained
Abyss Challenge will increase the Abyss Suppression effect for players, with one level of suppression added every 100 layers. The Abyss boss gains a strengthening effect for every 25% reduction in health.
Add Magic Gem System
By passing through 500 or more Abyss levels, you can gain 1 gem experience per level.
There is a chance for low-level strengthening stones to burst out at levels 600 or above, and high-level strengthening stones to burst out at levels 700 or above. The main attribute gems require one low-level strengthening stone to level 7, one high-level strengthening stone to level 10, and one low-level strengthening stone to level 5 for secondary attribute gems.
The highest level of a gemstone is 99, with 10 attributes added for every extra level.
The main attribute gemstones can carry up to three, and the secondary attribute gemstones can carry up to two.
Added 4 pieces of orange mana circulation leg armor, hero armor, bloodthirsty gloves, and charging shoes
Other updates
1. Added a combat interface timer.
2. Mage talent bug fix.
3. Increase the function of filtering imperfect equipment.
4. Add the property panel to redirect to the encyclopedia.

notes.title: V1.2.0 update
notes.notes:
Added the Eternal Tree, which can unlock excess coins to enhance the account's versatility.
Added two orange outfits, the Hammer of the Berserker and the Ring of the Ranger King
Gameplay adjustments
1. After automatic shutdown, it will return to the previous layer to continue automatic shutdown.
2. Automatic casting now allows all skills to be automatically released.
3. Slightly reduce critical hit rate, dodge rate, and multiple rate to ensure they are meaningful.
4. Perfect equipment with added logos
5. Change the minimum monster spawning time to 2 seconds

Author works 24-hour overnight for the update~~~Seeking positive feedback

notes.title: V1.1.0 update
notes.notes:
Now open Nightmare Challenge.
The Nightmare Challenge unlocks higher-level rewards by selecting the Nightmare effect, with a total of 5 levels of difficulty.
Each level of difficulty can provide different rewards, allowing you to obtain items such as up to+30 units, as well as powerful and rare Nightmare equipment.
Note that Nightmare Challenge only applies to levels above 200 levels.

Other updates
Fixed the issue of reinforcement probability exceeding 100% failure
Adjusted the attack and health of the monster's growth behind it
Adjusted the bonus of haste to attack speed and casting speed
Adjusted the percentage of critical strike multiple secondary attributes obtained
Adjusted the effect of 2/4 sets, now 3/6 pieces are needed to adapt to Nightmare equipment

A large number of legendary items will be updated next week.
